exceptions.reason: Build-machine only: Expo CLI manifest code signing; the app ships no expo-updates. Absent from the app bundle. Locally patched by patches/node-forge+1.4.0.patch (upstream PR 1152). Remove when node-forge 1.4.1 or later is installed.

Build-machine only: the zod 3.25.76 copy nested under Expo CLI. Expo CLI uses it only for its DevTools plugin and MCP CLI-extension schemas (@expo/cli build/src/start/server/DevToolsPlugin.schema.js and createMCPDevToolsExtensionSchema.js), which check developer-machine input: plugin metadata from locally installed packages and, in the optional MCP mode, local tool-call arguments. Absent from the app bundle; the app's own zod is 4.6.7, and this exception does not cover it. The fix shipped only in zod 4.6.6 (no fixed zod 3 release), and the newest @expo/cli for SDK 57 (57.0.32) still requires zod ^3.25.76. Remove when Expo CLI depends on zod 4.6.6 or later.

Locally patched: patches/decode-uri-component+0.2.2.patch carries the upstream 0.5.1 single-pass fix (commit fad01d6) inside the 0.2.2 CommonJS module that query-string 7 requires; upstream 0.5.x is ESM-only and would break that consumer. test/services/uriDecoderPatch.test.ts runs the installed module on 32,000 distinct percent-encoded runs under a 5-second deadline (the unpatched loop took about 28 seconds). Expo Router's link parser does not call this decoder (review M018). Remove when query-string no longer depends on decode-uri-component 0.2.x.
